services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The MacKenzie Art Gallery is one of the most picturesque venues in the city. This beautiful setting is an ideal place to make any event special. From meetings to wedding receptions and corporate galas, we provide an extraordinary event experience, including delicious and thoughtful on-site catering, all surrounded by the beauty of a world-class art museum. Our destination facility has a number of affordable and welcoming spaces perfect for a meeting for 20 to a reception for 400. “Sure, it’s not easy to pull off a one afternoon event but your staff did everything to make it possible to create a beautifully decorated space and host a wonderful 100th birthday party.
